newsitem.title: USA: "Face/Off" heads to top of U.S. box office.
newsitem.headline: "Face/Off" heads to top of U.S. box office.

text.p: "Face/Off," a violent thriller starring John Travolta and Nicolas Cage, opened at the top of the U.S. box office over the weekend, according to studio estimates issued on Sunday.
The movie earned about $22.7 million for the Friday-to-Sunday period, edging out second-placed "Hercules," which pulled in $21.5 million in its first weekend of wide release.
"Face/Off" marks the second time this month that Cage has starred in the number one movie. His "Con Air" topped the list in the June 7-9 weekend, and now ranks fifth with $5.5 million.
Last weekend's number one, "Batman & Robin," fell to third in its second weekend with $15.4 million, a slump of 64 percent.
The Julia Roberts romantic comedy "My Best Friend's Wedding" slipped two places to fourth with $15.3 million. Its 29 percent drop, however, was the smallest in the top 10.

"Face/Off" is released by Paramont Pictures, a unit of Viacom Inc.. "Hercules" and "Con Air" are released by Walt Disney Co.. "Batman & Robin" is released by Warner Bros, a unit of Time Warner Inc.. "My Best Friend's Wedding" is released by TriStar Pictures, a unit of Sony Corp..
